description: Backend fixes: (1) upgrade silent error discards to slog.Warn in identity/service.go, (2) make IssueCapForUser return bool and call it synchronously in auth/service.go with CapIssuanceFailed result field and 202 handler path, (3) add Gazi Bay Hamisi demo seed in seed/seed.go, (4) add GET /api/v1/activities/:id/detail endpoint in api/handlers.go + api/router.go.
steps: Step 1 — identity/service.go: Add 'log/slog' to the import block (currently absent). In IssueCapForUser, replace the two '_ = fmt.Errorf(...)' lines with slog.Warn calls. Replace '_ = s.db.Model(...)...Update("role_cap_object_id", ...)' with a checked 'if err := ...; err != nil { slog.Warn(...) }' block. Do the same DB-persist upgrade in IssueMonitorCapForUser. Do NOT change function signatures in this step.

Step 2 — identity/service.go: Change IssueCapForUser signature from void to 'bool'. Return false when IssueManagerCap or IssueVerifierCap returns an error (after the slog.Warn). Return true in the default branch and after successful link + persist. Keep 'go s.SyncToHub(...)' as a goroutine at the end of the success path.

Step 3 — auth/service.go: Add 'CapIssuanceFailed bool `json:"capIssuanceFailed,omitempty"`' field to the Result struct. In Register: remove the 'go s.identity.IssueCapForUser(...)' goroutine. Call synchronously: 'capOK := s.identity.IssueCapForUser(ctx, user.ID, role, provision)'. Immediately reload provision: 'if reloaded, reloadErr := s.identity.ForUser(user.ID); reloadErr == nil { provision = reloaded }'. Set 'result.Identity = provision'. If !capOK: set 'result.CapIssuanceFailed = true' and 'return result, nil' (no session token). Otherwise proceed to user.Status = models.IdentityActive and NewSession.

Step 4 — auth/handlers.go: In the Register handler, after the existing 'if err != nil { httpx.Error... return }' block and immediately before 'c.JSON(http.StatusCreated, result)', add: 'if result.CapIssuanceFailed { c.JSON(http.StatusAccepted, gin.H{"user": result.User, "identity": result.Identity, "capIssuanceFailed": true, "message": "Account created but role capability could not be issued on-chain. Login will retry cap issuance."}) return }'. The existing errors.Is(err, identity.ErrProvisioning) block is untouched.

Step 5 — seed/seed.go: Add 'github.com/baharilink/baharimrv/internal/provenance' to imports. Add package-level var gaziMonitors = []monitorSpec{{Email: demoEmail("said"), Name: "Said Bakari", Planted: 380, Alive: 341, Height: "0.920000", Species: "Ceriops tagal", Lat: -4.4224, Lng: 39.5108}, {Email: demoEmail("fatuma"), Name: "Fatuma Ali", Planted: 295, Alive: 271, Height: "0.760000", Species: "Ceriops tagal", Lat: -4.4231, Lng: 39.5115}}. Add gaziProject() function creating project 'Gazi Bay Mangrove Restoration (demo)' with plots GAZI-P1 and GAZI-P2 (3.0 ha each, Gazi Bay site). Add runGaziBay(ctx, db, hash, identities, projects, now) function: idempotency check on ConservationProject name; NOTE comment about Mikoko-must-run-first limitation; create Hamisi manager via account(); reuse MED-MANGROVE-DEMO methodology; call gaziProject(); assign monitors to plots; capture both; Complete only first activity; assert event.Status == provenance.StatusAnchored. Call runGaziBay from Run() after the Mikoko monitor loop block.

Step 6 — api/handlers.go: Add private struct types activityDetailView, monitoringRecordView, evidenceView, provView (exact fields from design §Task 4). Add firstSpecies(raw datatypes.JSON) string helper (unmarshal as []string first, then as bare string, fallback to string(raw)). Add func (r *router) activityDetail(c *gin.Context): access check via r.projects.AssertActivityAccess; load activity from r.db; build activityDetailView; load records via r.projects.RecordsFor; if records non-empty, build monitoringRecordView and load evidence via r.db.Where("monitoring_record_id = ?", rec.ID).Find(&evidenceObjects); load events via r.anchors.Events; if events non-empty, build provView with r.anchors.PublicNetwork() and r.anchors.ExplorerObject(latest) when status is provenance.StatusAnchored. c.JSON(200, view).
Step 7 — api/router.go: In the session group, after the line 'session.GET("/activities/:id/provenance", r.activityProvenance)', add 'session.GET("/activities/:id/detail", r.activityDetail)'.

findings: Backend GET /api/v1/activities/:id/detail is implemented and verified (build + go test ./internal/app/... pass). Findings for FEAT-002 (Android): (1) The endpoint response matches the design's activityDetailView shape exactly. (2) record.observations is returned as an empty string ("") in practice because models.MonitoringRecord does not persist an Observations column — the field is part of mrv.Payload but only hashed into ContentCommitment, not stored. The Android screen should treat empty/null observations as 'no observations' rather than erroring. (3) record.attestationStatement is populated from the model's Attestation field (the monitor's statement text), so it is non-empty for seeded/synced records. (4) provenance is null until the activity is completed and anchored; the first Gazi Bay plot (GAZI-P1) is anchored so its detail has a non-null provenance with explorerUrl, while GAZI-P2 has null provenance. (5) evidence array is populated for records that have uploaded evidence objects. (6) The Hamisi Mwangi manager account email is hamisi.manager@demo.baharimrv.local (demoEmail('hamisi.manager')); monitors are said@ and fatuma@ demo.baharimrv.local.
